question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose` and `openclaw sessions diagnose` as supported core operator/client diagnosis contracts for this release?
rationale: The patch is additive and appears technically sound, but it creates durable public Gateway, CLI, protocol, docs, and Swift model surface that automation should not approve without maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept The Diagnosis Contract
options.body: Record maintainer acceptance of the new read-only Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model, and result vocabulary, then proceed through normal merge gates.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Trim fields, finding codes, CLI output, or Swift exposure before landing if maintainers want a smaller compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer To Recovery Work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if core should wait for the broader stuck-session diagnostics and recovery direction before adding a public API.

recommendation.title: Accept The Diagnosis Contract
recommendation.body: Record maintainer acceptance of the new read-only Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model, and result vocabulary, then proceed through normal merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate from adjacent Gateway server-method validation history and prior session API review context.
